papers.title: Advances in thiolated chitosan (TCS) for wound healing: Mechanisms, therapeutic applications and translational perspectives - A review.
papers.abstract: Wound healing, especially in chronic, diabetic, and infected conditions, remains a major clinical challenge due to the limitations of existing topical therapies and dressings. Thiolated chitosan (TCS), a chemically modified derivative of chitosan (CS), offers a multifunctional solution by addressing the diverse biological demands of wound repair. This review presents an integrative perspective on the potential of TCS as a next-generation topical biomaterial. We discuss the molecular basis of thiolation, highlighting improvements in mucoadhesion, redox-responsiveness, and drug permeation compared to native CS. TCS exhibits significant biological effects, enhancing hemostasis, modulating inflammation, stimulating cellular proliferation, and promoting angiogenesis and extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling. Additionally, TCS demonstrates potent antimicrobial and antibiofilm capabilities through membrane disruption and redox interference, with synergistic benefits when combined with antibiotics or metallic ions. We also explored its incorporation into smart hydrogels, bioactive dressings and multi-modal wound healing platforms that integrate regenerative, immunomodulatory, and responsive release strategies. Specialized applications in corneal and diabetic wounds, along with findings from in vitro and in vivo preclinical studies, underscore its therapeutic versatility. Despite promising results, challenges such as synthesis reproducibility, long-term stability, and limited clinical data remain. Future directions emphasize advancements in 3D bioprinting, sensor-enabled dressings, and AI-driven wound care systems. Overall, TCS emerges as a promising platform technology poised to transform precision wound healing through its integrative, multi-targeted approach.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该综述主要讨论硫醇化壳聚糖在伤口愈合中的机制和应用，仅在未来展望中提及3D生物打印和AI驱动系统，未涉及AI与生物打印的具体集成。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a review on thiolated chitosan for wound healing, with no AI integration into bioprinting workflow, no experimental validation of AI models, and no autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 慢性伤口愈合仍是临床挑战，现有敷料存在局限。
summary_zh.method: 综述硫醇化壳聚糖的分子修饰、生物学效应及智能敷料设计。
summary_zh.result: TCS通过多靶点机制促进伤口愈合，但临床转化仍面临挑战。
summary_zh.validation: 引用体外和体内临床前研究，但无AI相关验证。

summary_en.motivation: Chronic and diabetic wound healing remains a major clinical challenge due to limitations of current topical therapies.
summary_en.method: This review summarizes the molecular basis of thiolated chitosan, its biological effects, and its incorporation into smart hydrogels and multi-modal wound healing platforms.
summary_en.result: Thiolated chitosan demonstrates multifunctional benefits including hemostasis, immunomodulation, and antimicrobial activity, but clinical translation is hindered by reproducibility and stability issues.
summary_en.validation: The review references in vitro and in vivo preclinical studies, but no AI or bioprinting validation is included.

papers.title: Design of hierarchical structures and mechanical properties of 316 L stainless steel FCC lattice structures by laser powder bed fusion
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory of Superlight Materials & Surface Technology, Ministry of Education, College of Materials Science and Chemical Engineering, Harbin Engineering University, Harbin 150001, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yi-Xiang Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory of Superlight Materials & Surface Technology, Ministry of Education, College of Materials Science and Chemical Engineering, Harbin Engineering University, Harbin 150001, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了316L不锈钢FCC点阵结构的LPBF制备与力学性能，但未涉及应力遮挡或生物医学植入物背景。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration or surface morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索316L不锈钢FCC点阵结构的设计与力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用激光粉末床熔融制备分级FCC点阵结构并进行压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 分级结构表现出优于均匀结构的力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态压缩实验验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the design and mechanical performance of hierarchical FCC lattice structures in 316L stainless steel fabricated by LPBF.
summary_en.method: Hierarchical FCC lattice structures were designed and manufactured via laser powder bed fusion, followed by quasi-static compression testing.
summary_en.result: Hierarchical structures exhibited enhanced mechanical properties compared to uniform counterparts.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through quasi-static compression experiments.

papers.title: Dynamic Resilience Assessment of Power Systems With Data Center Load Events Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Large data center loads introduce new resilience challenges to power systems because their disconnection and staged reconnection can induce fast voltage and frequency dynamics that are not captured by static service-status or energy-based metrics. This paper proposes a utility-side, physics-informed resilience assessment framework that evaluates these events using only grid-side dynamic models and observable post-disturbance trajectories, without requiring detailed internal data center models. An unsupervised differential algebraic equation-physics informed neural network (DAE-PINN) based on an implicit backward Euler residual is developed to jointly predict dynamic and algebraic states, enabling repeated post-disturbance trajectory evaluation while enforcing network algebraic consistency. Normalized multi-phase resilience metrics are then used to quantify disturbance, degraded-state, and restoration-period impacts and to screen data center reconnection timing and load-ramping strategies under security constraints. Case studies on a modified IEEE 33-bus feeder show that the proposed DAE-PINN accurately tracks numerical DAE solutions and substantially reduces computation time in repeated restoration screening. The proposed metrics distinguish the effects of disturbance size, data center location, and reconnection strategy, revealing the trade-off between restoration speed and transient resilience loss.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN应用于电力系统动态弹性评估，与生物力学或植入物设计中的有限元代理建模无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper applies PINN to power system dynamics, not to solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanical FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 数据中心负荷事件对电力系统弹性构成挑战，现有指标无法捕捉快速动态。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于DAE-PINN的无监督框架，利用隐式后向欧拉残差预测动态和代数状态。
summary_zh.result: 在IEEE 33节点系统上准确跟踪数值解，显著降低重复评估计算时间。
summary_zh.validation: 通过修改的IEEE 33节点馈线系统仿真案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Large data center loads introduce fast voltage and frequency dynamics that static metrics fail to capture, motivating a physics-informed resilience assessment framework.
summary_en.method: An unsupervised DAE-PINN with implicit backward Euler residual is developed to jointly predict dynamic and algebraic states for repeated post-disturbance trajectory evaluation.
summary_en.result: The DAE-PINN accurately tracks numerical DAE solutions on a modified IEEE 33-bus feeder and substantially reduces computation time in restoration screening.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation case studies on a modified IEEE 33-bus power system feeder.
